_published_faq.name: How do I add Norton to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Norton to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai-connect.norton.com/claude/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Norton MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Norton scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Norton MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Norton provides these MCP tools: cybersafety_scam_check, cybersafety_threat_advisor, product_kb_support, message, email, troubleshooting, and recommendations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Norton?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Norton in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
Norton does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
